comments.author: Alrn
comments.body:
And.. they also translated new discoveries as well. Not bad :o

Anyway, this can be found in Java Island Interior (you need Borobudur Temple discovery from quest "Long slumbering ruins" to unlock this inland in Island of Java North Coast) with Rank 11 Recognition or more, i can't really sure but it needs high rank. Around middle-southwest part of the map during Night and Clear Sky. It's really hard to notice the lava because it took few seconds for you to notice the lava appearance. Good luck :)

comments.author: BlueSiren
comments.body: Found in Island of Java North Coast. r12 recognition is needed.
